source.author: prop
source.text: centum illi in prato saepe senatus erat.
source.text_original: centum illi in prato saepe senatus erat.
source.text_english: For him, that hundred was often a senate in the meadow.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: de quo senatu Propertius elegiarum scriptor haec loquitur: bucina cogebat priscos ad uerba Quirites, centum illi in prato saepe senatus erat .
reuse.text_original: de quo senatu Propertius elegiarum scriptor haec loquitur: bucina cogebat priscos ad uerba Quirites, centum illi in prato saepe senatus erat .
reuse.text_english: Concerning which senate the writer of elegies Propertius speaks thus: the bugle used to summon the ancient Quirites to assembly; those hundred men in the meadow were often a senate.
